description: This file contains unit tests for the ActiveSessions class in a C++ project, specifically testing session creation, retrieval, and removal behaviors using Google Test framework.

classes.name: ActiveSessionsTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing ActiveSessions behaviors, setting up mocks and callbacks.

methods.name: GetShouldReturnNullWhenSessionIsNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a session by key ID returns null if the session does not exist.

methods.name: ShouldCreateSessionGetShouldFailForUknownKey
methods.description: Tests that creating a session and then attempting to retrieve a non-existent key returns null.

methods.name: ShouldCreateSessionGetShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that a created session can be retrieved successfully.

methods.name: SessionShouldExistUntilLastInstanceIsRemoved
methods.description: Ensures that a session remains retrievable until it is explicitly removed twice.
